# MarketForge Podcast Strategy

Apply V3 §3.11.

## Global quality rules

- Hosting: works at 5-figure ACVs and up; theater below.
- Guesting: lower-cost, higher-leverage for most SMBs.
- Refine Labs Walker data: podcast was attributed to 53% of revenue via self-report but 0% via software-based attribution — the dark-social gap.
- All tiers viable for guesting.
- AI-automatable for outreach + repurposing; the conversation itself is human.

## Purpose

1. Strategy decision (host / guest / both).
2. For hosting: format, cadence, production tier, guest pipeline.
3. For guesting: target podcast list, pitch system, talking points.
4. Repurposing pipeline.
5. Attribution (self-report essential).

## Inputs
- `channel-strategy.md`, `brand-strategy.md`, `narrative-and-story.md`, `icp-and-personas/`.

## Outputs
- `docs/marketing-plan/07-organic-social/podcast-strategy.md`
- DEC-454 to DEC-459

## Structure

```markdown
# Podcast Strategy

## Strategy decision

### Hosting (T3+ + 5-figure ACV+)
- Justified when: high-ACV ($25K+) B2B with budget for production + dedicated role.
- Production cost: $1-5K/episode at T2 quality; $5-20K at T3 quality.
- Cadence: weekly when justified; biweekly more sustainable.
- Format options:
  - Interview-style with industry leaders (audience-building).
  - Customer / case study format (sales-enablement-leaning).
  - Founder solo POV (founder-brand-leaning).

### Guesting (all tiers)
- Target: 10-15 mid-tier podcasts/year with audience overlap.
- Pitch system: dedicated PR (or AI-assisted outreach + human follow-up).
- Talking points: 2-3 specific POVs the founder consistently defends.

## Guesting pitch system

### Target list
- 30-50 podcasts in target category.
- Audience size: 5K-50K downloads per episode (mid-tier).
- ICP overlap: high.
- Mainstream podcasts (Top 100 in category) require strong PR + warm intros.

### Pitch
- Subject: specific topic + your POV.
- Body: 4-6 sentences.
  - Sentence 1: Specific value to their audience.
  - Sentence 2: Why you specifically (credential / data / contrarian POV).
  - Sentence 3: 2-3 episode topics you'd be great on.
  - Sentence 4: Reference to one of their recent episodes (proof of listening).
  - Sentence 5: Soft CTA ("Worth a chat?" or "Happy to send more.").

### Outreach cadence
- Initial pitch.
- Day +7: follow-up.
- Day +21: third touch with new angle.
- Day +60: close-the-loop or new pitch later.

### Tools
- Podchaser for podcast discovery.
- ListenNotes for episode-level data.
- Apollo / Clay for host email finding.

## Hosting (when justified)

### Format
- Interview vs solo vs panel.
- Length: 30-60 min typical.
- Visual: video version for YouTube + clips.

### Cadence
- Weekly: aspirational but hard to sustain at quality.
- Biweekly: sustainable for most.
- Monthly: hits attention threshold less reliably.

### Production tier
- T1: founder + Riverside + DIY editing.
- T2: producer contractor.
- T3: in-house producer + editor + ops.

### Guest pipeline
- Outreach + scheduling.
- Quality control (do they speak to your audience?).
- Co-promotion expectations (guest shares episode).

## Repurposing pipeline

Per episode:
- Full audio: published.
- YouTube full video.
- 3-5 short clips for TikTok / IG Reels / X / LinkedIn.
- Pull quote cards for social.
- Blog post adaptation.
- Newsletter inclusion.
- Snippet for podcast trailer.

## Attribution

Podcast is the canonical dark-social channel:
- Platform-reported = ~0.
- Self-report survey = 30-50% in some cases.
- Brand-search lift after episodes.
- DM-driven inbound mentioning specific episode.

Be explicit in attribution stack that podcast is dark-social; don't trust platform-reported zeros.

## Decision cards
[DEC-454 to DEC-459]

## Kill criteria
- Hosting: 6-12 months; aided awareness flat + no branded-search lift + no dark-social attribution signal → re-evaluate.
- Guesting: 12 months; 10+ guestings without measurable signup lift or audience response → re-evaluate pitch / targeting.

## What we are intentionally NOT doing
- Hosting before T3 + 5-figure ACV (theater).
- Skipping repurposing pipeline (most value left on table).
- Trusting platform attribution alone for podcast.

## Sources and basis
V3 §3.11.
Refine Labs / Chris Walker attribution mirage data — evidence D with practitioner corroboration.
```
